decision.eligible_wire: canonical positive decimal integer token <= 9007199254740991, exact numeric roundtrip, plus full admitted native type/source/serving/runtime provenance
decision.integral_decimal_exponent: unresolved representation; nonprojectable; invalid-reference with representation-ambiguous reason
decision.unproved_native_type: no eligibility even for canonical decimal wire token
decision.invalid_reference: retain identifiable location and exact raw/wire evidence; no dependent target query
decision.invalid_admission_or_identity: refuse affected admission/read; retain previously established parents and visible error/incomplete evidence
